# Code of Conduct

This repository is a personal collection of UQ course notes. This Code of
Conduct applies to its issues, pull requests, discussions, and other
repository spaces.

## Expected behaviour

Be respectful, constructive, and patient. Discuss the notes and the change,
not the person. Corrections and different explanations are welcome when they
are offered in good faith.

## Unacceptable behaviour

Unacceptable behaviour includes:

- harassment, intimidation, discrimination, or personal attacks
- sharing another person's private information without permission
- spam, advertising, or unrelated promotion
- plagiarism or misrepresenting someone else's work as your own
- posting restricted course material, leaked assessments, or current
  assessment solutions
- deliberately disrupting issues, reviews, or the published site

Anyone asked to stop unacceptable behaviour must do so immediately.

## Academic integrity and AI-assisted work

Follow the academic-integrity rules that apply to you and the relevant course.
Only contribute material you are allowed to share, written in your own words
with sources acknowledged where needed.

AI-assisted contributions are permitted only when they follow those rules.
You remain responsible for checking their accuracy, licensing, privacy, and
originality. Do not submit generated material that you cannot explain or
verify.

## Reporting and enforcement

Report conduct concerns privately to the maintainer, `@keys-i`, where
possible. Do not include personal or sensitive details in a public issue.
GitHub or UQ reporting channels may be more appropriate for serious matters.

The maintainer may edit or remove contributions, close discussions, or
restrict participation when needed to protect this repository and its
contributors.
